Quelccaya Glacier: essential travel information

The Quelccaya Glacier is one of Peru’s most impressive natural wonders. Located in the Vilcanota mountain range, southeast of Cusco, it is considered the largest tropical glacier in the world and a unique destination for travelers seeking adventure and untouched landscapes.

Location: Cusco – Canchis Province
⏱ Travel time from Cusco: 5–6 hours
Altitude: Over 5,000 meters (16,400 ft)

Best time to visit Quelccaya Glacier

April – October (dry season)

Sunny days and clear skies
Safer trails and better visibility
Ideal for trekking and landscape photography

Tip: Acclimatize in Cusco before visiting due to the high altitude.

Rainy season

November – March

Frequent afternoon rain and cold temperatures
Greener landscapes and fewer tourists
Recommended only with experienced tour operators

Best balance months

April and October offer a great combination of good weather and fewer visitors.
